system.description:
Usable by all spellcasters.

Forged for absolute dominance over the living world, this heavy wooden staff allows its wielder to bend beasts, humanoids, and plant life to their absolute will.

When focusing on the natural kingdom, the wielder can command [[/r 1d6 #number of animals controlled]] normal animals—or a single giant-sized specimen—provided the creatures are within their line of sight. These targets are allowed no saving throw to resist the compulsion, though intelligent species, magical beasts, and fantastic monsters are completely immune.

When turning the staff toward humanity, the wielder can subjugate up to 6 Hit Dice of humans at once, with normal men counting as 1/2 Hit Die each, operating much like a charm person spell with a range of 60 feet.

Finally, the wielder can command all plants and plantlike creatures, including terrifying plant monsters, residing within a 30' x 30' area up to 60 feet away. While normal plants commanded this way cannot inflict physical damage, they can weave together to ruthlessly entangle any victims caught within their area.

The greatest burden of the staff is its absolute requirement of focus. The duration for all effects lasts precisely as long as the caster maintains concentration. While concentrating, the wielder cannot move or fight whatsoever. The moment concentration lapses—whether voluntarily or through interruption—all commands immediately break. The controlled humans and plants return to their senses, while freed animals roll reactions with a -1 penalty, leaving them just as likely to flee into the shadows as they are to turn and savagely attack their former controller. Furthermore, the animal-commanding property can only be used once per turn.
system.unidentifiedDesc: This staff has a sturdy, polished appearance, made from a rich, dark wood. The top is adorned with a beautifully carved symbol of healing, surrounded by intricate designs that evoke a sense of divine power.
